CREATE TABLE "public"."AuditLog" (
  "action" character varying(120) NOT NULL,
  "actorUserId" uuid,
  "afterData" jsonb,
  "beforeData" jsonb,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "ipAddress" character varying(64),
  "metadata" jsonb,
  "organizationId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "outcome" character varying(30) DEFAULT 'SUCCESS' NOT NULL,
  "propertyId" uuid,
  "reason" text,
  "requestId" character varying(100),
  "resourceId" character varying(100),
  "resourceType" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "userAgent" character varying(500),
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Folio" (
  "closedAt" timestamp(3),
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "currencyCode" character varying(3) DEFAULT 'INR' NOT NULL,
  "folioNo" character varying(50) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "openedAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "propertyId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "reservationId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "status" "FolioStatus" DEFAULT 'OPEN'::"FolioStatus" NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."FolioItem" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" character varying(300) NOT NULL,
  "folioId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "idempotencyKey" character varying(120),
  "isVoided" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "postedById" uuid,
  "quantity" numeric(10,2) DEFAULT '1'::numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  "reason" text,
  "taxAmount" numeric(12,2) DEFAULT '0'::numeric(12,2) NOT NULL,
  "taxSnapshot" jsonb,
  "totalAmount" numeric(12,2) DEFAULT '0'::numeric(12,2) NOT NULL,
  "type" "FolioItemType" NOT NULL,
  "unitAmount" numeric(12,2) DEFAULT '0'::numeric(12,2) NOT NULL,
  "voidedAt" timestamp(3),
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Guest" (
  "addressLine1" character varying(200),
  "addressLine2" character varying(200),
  "city" character varying(100),
  "companyName" character varying(200),
  "countryCode" character varying(2),
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" character varying(320),
  "firstName" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "internalNotes" text,
  "lastName" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "organizationId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "phone" character varying(40),
  "postalCode" character varying(30),
  "preferences" text,
  "region" character varying(100),
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."HousekeepingTask" (
  "assignedToId" uuid,
  "blockedReason" text,
  "completedAt" timestamp(3),
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "createdById" uuid,
  "dueAt" timestamp(3),
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "inspectedAt" timestamp(3),
  "notes" text,
  "priority" "TaskPriority" DEFAULT 'NORMAL'::"TaskPriority" NOT NULL,
  "propertyId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "roomId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "startedAt" timestamp(3),
  "status" "HousekeepingTaskStatus" DEFAULT 'TODO'::"HousekeepingTaskStatus" NOT NULL,
  "type" "HousekeepingTaskType" NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Invoice" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "currencyCode" character varying(3) NOT NULL,
  "folioId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "invoiceNo" character varying(60) NOT NULL,
  "issuedAt" timestamp(3),
  "propertyId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "status" "InvoiceStatus" DEFAULT 'DRAFT'::"InvoiceStatus" NOT NULL,
  "subtotal" numeric(12,2) DEFAULT '0'::numeric(12,2) NOT NULL,
  "taxTotal" numeric(12,2) DEFAULT '0'::numeric(12,2) NOT NULL,
  "totalAmount" numeric(12,2) DEFAULT '0'::numeric(12,2) NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "voidReason" text,
  "voidedAt" timestamp(3),
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."MaintenanceTicket" (
  "assignedToId" uuid,
  "category" "MaintenanceCategory" DEFAULT 'OTHER'::"MaintenanceCategory" NOT NULL,
  "closedAt" timestamp(3),
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "priority" "MaintenancePriority" DEFAULT 'NORMAL'::"MaintenancePriority" NOT NULL,
  "propertyId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "reportedById" uuid,
  "resolution" text,
  "resolvedAt" timestamp(3),
  "roomId" uuid,
  "status" "MaintenanceStatus" DEFAULT 'OPEN'::"MaintenanceStatus" NOT NULL,
  "ticketNo" character varying(50) NOT NULL,
  "title" character varying(200) NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."NightAudit" (
  "businessDate" date NOT NULL,
  "completedAt" timestamp(3),
  "completedById" uuid,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "exceptionSummary" jsonb,
  "finalSummary" jsonb,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "idempotencyKey" character varying(120),
  "previewSummary" jsonb,
  "propertyId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "reopenReason" text,
  "reopenedAt" timestamp(3),
  "startedAt" timestamp(3),
  "startedById" uuid,
  "status" "NightAuditStatus" DEFAULT 'PREVIEWED'::"NightAuditStatus" NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Notification" (
  "body" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "propertyId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "readAt" timestamp(3),
  "targetPath" character varying(500),
  "title" character varying(200) NOT NULL,
  "type" "NotificationType" NOT NULL,
  "userId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Organization" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "name" character varying(200) NOT NULL,
  "slug" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "status" "OrganizationStatus" DEFAULT 'ACTIVE'::"OrganizationStatus" NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Payment" (
  "amount" numeric(12,2) NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "currencyCode" character varying(3) NOT NULL,
  "folioId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "idempotencyKey" character varying(120),
  "method" "PaymentMethod" NOT NULL,
  "provider" character varying(100),
  "reason" text,
  "receivedById" uuid,
  "recordedAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "reference" character varying(200),
  "refundedAt" timestamp(3),
  "settledAt" timestamp(3),
  "status" "PaymentStatus" DEFAULT 'PENDING'::"PaymentStatus" NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Permission" (
  "action" character varying(80) NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" character varying(500),
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "key" character varying(120) NOT NULL,
  "resource" character varying(80) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Property" (
  "addressLine1" character varying(200),
  "addressLine2" character varying(200),
  "checkInTime" character varying(5) DEFAULT '14:00' NOT NULL,
  "checkOutTime" character varying(5) DEFAULT '11:00' NOT NULL,
  "city" character varying(100),
  "countryCode" character varying(2) DEFAULT 'IN' NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "currencyCode" character varying(3) DEFAULT 'INR' NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "isActive" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "name" character varying(200) NOT NULL,
  "organizationId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "postalCode" character varying(30),
  "region" character varying(100),
  "slug" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "taxInclusivePricing" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "timezone" character varying(100) DEFAULT 'Asia/Kolkata' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."PropertyMembership" (
  "acceptedAt" timestamp(3),
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "invitedAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "isActive" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "propertyId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "roleId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "userId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."RatePlan" (
  "cancellationPolicy" text,
  "code" character varying(40) NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "currencyCode" character varying(3) DEFAULT 'INR' NOT NULL,
  "defaultNightlyRate" numeric(12,2) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "isActive" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "isRefundable" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "minStayNights" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "name" character varying(120) NOT NULL,
  "propertyId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "roomTypeId" uuid,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."RatePlanPrice" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "minimumStayNights" int4,
  "nightlyRate" numeric(12,2) NOT NULL,
  "ratePlanId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "stayDate" date NOT NULL,
  "stopSell" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Reservation" (
  "adults" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "bookingCode" character varying(40) NOT NULL,
  "cancellationReason" text,
  "cancelledAt" timestamp(3),
  "checkInDate" date NOT NULL,
  "checkOutDate" date NOT NULL,
  "checkedInAt" timestamp(3),
  "checkedOutAt" timestamp(3),
  "children" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "createdById" uuid,
  "currencyCode" character varying(3) DEFAULT 'INR' NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "primaryGuestId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "propertyId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "source" "BookingSource" DEFAULT 'DIRECT'::"BookingSource" NOT NULL,
  "specialRequests" text,
  "status" "ReservationStatus" DEFAULT 'DRAFT'::"ReservationStatus" NOT NULL,
  "subtotal" numeric(12,2) DEFAULT '0'::numeric(12,2) NOT NULL,
  "taxTotal" numeric(12,2) DEFAULT '0'::numeric(12,2) NOT NULL,
  "totalAmount" numeric(12,2) DEFAULT '0'::numeric(12,2) NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."ReservationRoom" (
  "adults" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "children" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "nightlyRate" numeric(12,2) DEFAULT '0'::numeric(12,2) NOT NULL,
  "ratePlanId" uuid,
  "ratePlanName" character varying(120),
  "reservationId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "roomId" uuid,
  "roomTypeId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Role" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" character varying(500),
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "isActive" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "isSystem" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "key" character varying(60) NOT NULL,
  "name" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "organizationId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."RolePermission" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "permissionId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "roleId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("roleId", "permissionId")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Room" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "floor" character varying(30),
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "isActive" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "propertyId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "roomNumber" character varying(30) NOT NULL,
  "roomTypeId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "status" "RoomStatus" DEFAULT 'VACANT_DIRTY'::"RoomStatus" NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "wing" character varying(50),
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."RoomNightInventory" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "reservationRoomId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "roomId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "stayDate" date NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."RoomType" (
  "amenities" jsonb,
  "baseOccupancy" int4 DEFAULT 2 NOT NULL,
  "baseRate" numeric(12,2) DEFAULT '0'::numeric(12,2) NOT NULL,
  "code" character varying(40) NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "isActive" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "maxAdults" int4 DEFAULT 2 NOT NULL,
  "maxChildren" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "name" character varying(120) NOT NULL,
  "propertyId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Session" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expiresAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "ipAddress" character varying(64),
  "lastSeenAt" timestamp(3),
  "revokedAt" timestamp(3),
  "tokenHash" character varying(255) NOT NULL,
  "userAgent" character varying(500),
  "userId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."TaxRule" (
  "appliesTo" "TaxAppliesTo" DEFAULT 'ALL'::"TaxAppliesTo" NOT NULL,
  "code" character varying(40) NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "isActive" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "isCompound" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "isInclusive" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "name" character varying(120) NOT NULL,
  "propertyId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "ratePercent" numeric(7,4) NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "validFrom" date,
  "validTo" date,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."User" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" character varying(320) NOT NULL,
  "emailVerifiedAt" timestamp(3),
  "fullName" character varying(200) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "lastLoginAt" timestamp(3),
  "passwordChangedAt" timestamp(3),
  "passwordHash" character varying(255),
  "status" "UserStatus" DEFAULT 'INVITED'::"UserStatus" NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."UserThemePreference" (
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "propertyId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "themeKey" "ThemeKey" DEFAULT 'LUXURY_BEIGE_TAUPE'::"ThemeKey" NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "userId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
